property_summary: For any order with expiration strictly in the future, fillOrder must accept it and set positionExpirations for the long leg to (block.timestamp + duration); the flipped-check mutant rejects every such non-expired order, so on an admissible input where the reference succeeds and writes a non-zero expiration, the mutant reverts (ok=false) and leaves positionExpirations unchanged.
change_summary: Change the expiration check from '<' to '>', reverting on expired orders but allowing expired ones through.
